name: $C_4$-Trees Are Strictly $C_4$-Cactoids
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every $C_4$-tree is a $C_4$-cactoid, and the containment is strict.
proof: A $C_4$-tree supplies one allowed nontrivial block. The single edge $K_2$ is a $C_4$-cactoid but is not a $C_4$-tree.
